name: Claude Code
note: Your Claude login on this Mac is not visible in the box.

secrets.label: Claude subscription token (run claude setup-token on this Mac)

setup: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then (umask 077; f="$HOME/.claude.json"; [ -e "$f" ] || printf '{}' > "$f"; /usr/bin/jq '.hasCompletedOnboarding = true' "$f" > "$f.avm" 2>/dev/null && /bin/mv "$f.avm" "$f" || /bin/rm -f "$f.avm"); fi
